description.nature: An analytics storage bucket holding nightly order exports was publicly listable after an access-policy change during a migration.
description.extent: 9 export files downloaded from outside addresses: about 46,000 order rows relating to about 27,800 customers. Exposure lasted about 19 days.
description.location: Cloud storage bucket used for order analytics (fictional Plumvale Online Store).
description.likelyImpact: Exposure of delivery addresses, phone numbers and items ordered.
description.consequencesForPrincipals: Possible unsolicited contact or fraud attempts using order details.
description.eventsCircumstancesReasons: Access policy on the bucket was changed in error during a storage migration; no alert covered public access.

implemented: Public-access block applied at account level
safetyMeasuresForPrincipals: Be cautious of calls or messages that quote an order
Plumvale will never ask for a one-time password
